objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Read another user's ticket: the admin's ticket is the flag.
hints: The ticket route takes a user id from its URL and never checks who asks.
Read about insecure direct object references (broken access control).

steps.title: Find the route
steps.prompt: Which route returns a ticket? (path, without the id)

steps.prompt: What class of vulnerability is this? (acronym accepted)
